images.caption: A gloomy afternoon at the Piedmont Triad Airport (GSO). The neon gate numbers are no longer used. It's still a very convenient and quiet airport and fairly-priced considering its competition from Charlotte and Raleigh-Durham. It was also built for Piedmont/US Airways to use as a hub, but 80% of its capacity is never used.
